# redacting-logger

> JSON log formatter and filter for stdlib logging that redacts secrets and personal data by key name and by bounded value patterns Python package `trysac-redacting-logger`, import name `redacting_logger`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
